name: mamaearth tea tree facewash
ingredients_raw: Removes Excess Oil Anti-Bacterial DERMATOLOGICALLY TESTED pH BALANCED. FREE OF SLES, SULFATES, PHTHALATES, SILICONES INGREDIENTS: Aqua, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Decyl Glucoside, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Glycerin, Caprylylt/Capryl Glucoside, Acrylates Copolymer, Sodium Lauroyl Oat Amino Acids, Sodium PCA, Betaine Anhydrous, Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate, Polysorbate 20, Phenoxyethanol, Guar Gum, IFRA Certified Allergen Free Fragrance. Aloe Vera Extract, Neem Leaf Extract, Lavender Oil, D-Panthenol, Disodium EDTA, Ethylhexylglycerin & Tea Tree Oil. DIRECTIONS FOR USE: Apply a small amount on wet face and gently massage with your fingertips in a circular motion. Concentrate on forehead. nose and chin, Rinse off with water and pat dry Avoid direct contact with eyes. Product contains natural ingredients & may change color and fragrance, without losing effectiveness. Even natural ingredients can cause and trigger existing allergies, patch test recommended. Results may vary.
